project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and instant payments

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code, refresh tokens) with JWT access tokens, scopes and token revocation for the mobile banking app.

components.name: Instant payments gateway integration
components.description: Integration with a SEPA instant payments provider including idempotent transfers, reconciliation jobs and webhook handling for settlement events.

components.name: Push notification service
components.description: Transactional push notifications for payment confirmations and security alerts via APNs and FCM with per-user delivery preferences.

components.name: Operations admin dashboard
components.description: Internal back-office dashboard to inspect transactions, freeze accounts and review fraud flags, with role-based access control.

project_summary: Headless e-commerce storefront with real-time search and one-page checkout

components.name: Shopping cart and session management
components.description: Persistent shopping cart with guest and logged-in merge, stock reservation and price recalculation on every mutation.

components.name: Real-time product search
components.description: Faceted product search with typo tolerance, synonyms and relevance tuning powered by Elasticsearch and an indexing pipeline.

components.name: One-page checkout with Stripe
components.description: Single-page checkout flow with Stripe payment intents, address validation, tax calculation and order creation.

components.name: Catalog content management
components.description: Headless CMS integration to manage products, categories and merchandising blocks with preview and scheduled publishing.

project_summary: Electronic health record platform with appointment scheduling and FHIR interoperability

components.name: Electronic health records core
components.description: Clinical records module storing encounters, diagnoses and medications with full audit trail and field-level access control for GDPR compliance.

components.name: Appointment scheduling
components.description: Multi-practitioner calendar with availability rules, overbooking prevention and patient self-booking with reminders.

components.name: HL7 / FHIR integration
components.description: Bidirectional HL7 v2 and FHIR R4 integration with hospital systems for patient demographics and lab orders.

components.name: Patient portal
components.description: Read-only patient portal to view appointments, prescriptions and lab results with secure messaging.

project_summary: Industrial IoT platform for SCADA telemetry, predictive maintenance and shop-floor execution

components.name: SCADA telemetry ingestion
components.description: High-throughput ingestion of sensor telemetry over MQTT and OPC-UA with backpressure handling and time-series storage.

components.name: Predictive maintenance engine
components.description: Machine-learning pipeline that scores equipment failure risk from vibration and temperature signals and raises maintenance work orders.

components.name: Manufacturing execution module
components.description: Shop-floor execution tracking of work orders, machine states and OEE metrics with operator terminals.

components.name: Operational reporting
components.description: Scheduled and ad-hoc reports on throughput, downtime and maintenance costs exported to PDF and Excel.

project_summary: Cloud-native card issuing platform with ledger, KYC onboarding and webhooks

components.name: Double-entry ledger
components.description: Immutable double-entry accounting ledger with strong consistency, balance snapshots and audit export for financial reconciliation.

components.name: KYC / AML onboarding
components.description: Identity verification and anti-money-laundering screening with document checks, sanctions lists and risk scoring during customer onboarding.

components.name: Card issuing API
components.description: Virtual and physical card issuing integrated with a BIN sponsor, including card lifecycle and 3-D Secure authentication.

components.name: Webhook delivery
components.description: Reliable outbound webhook delivery with retries, signing and a replay endpoint for partner integrations.

project_summary: Online grocery store with delivery slot scheduling and loyalty programme

components.name: Product catalog
components.description: Grocery catalog with variants, units of measure, perishables and per-store availability.

components.name: Order management
components.description: Order lifecycle from basket to fulfilment with substitutions, refunds and picker app integration.

components.name: Delivery slot scheduling
components.description: Capacity-aware delivery slot booking with route-based availability and dynamic cut-off times.

components.name: Loyalty points
components.description: Loyalty programme accruing and redeeming points with tiered benefits and coupon generation.

project_summary: Telemedicine platform with video consultations, e-prescription and insurance billing

components.name: Telemedicine video consultations
components.description: WebRTC-based video visits with waiting room, screen sharing and session recording compliant with HIPAA.

components.name: E-prescription
components.description: Electronic prescribing with drug-interaction checks and transmission to pharmacies via Surescripts.

components.name: Insurance billing
components.description: Claims generation and submission in X12 837 format with eligibility checks and denial management.

components.name: SMS appointment reminders
components.description: Automated SMS reminders and follow-up surveys via Twilio with opt-out handling.

project_summary: Smart factory quality control with PLC connectivity and machine vision

components.name: PLC data connector
components.description: Connector reading tags from Siemens and Allen-Bradley PLCs and normalising them into a unified telemetry stream.

components.name: Machine-vision quality control
components.description: Defect detection on the production line using a computer-vision model with operator review and rejection routing.

components.name: Inventory synchronisation
components.description: Two-way inventory sync between the factory MES and the corporate ERP with conflict resolution.

components.name: Single sign-on
components.description: SSO for operator terminals against the corporate Active Directory with badge-based fast login.

project_summary: Retail investing app with portfolio analytics, market data and price alerts

components.name: Portfolio analytics
components.description: Portfolio valuation, performance attribution and risk metrics computed from positions and corporate actions.

components.name: Market data feed
components.description: Real-time and end-of-day market data ingestion from a vendor feed with normalisation and caching.

components.name: Price alerts
components.description: User-defined price and percentage-move alerts evaluated against the live feed with push and email delivery.

components.name: Two-factor authentication
components.description: TOTP-based two-factor authentication with device binding and recovery codes for account security.

project_summary: Cross-platform fashion shopping app with recommendations and mobile wallets

components.name: Mobile storefront
components.description: React Native storefront with product browsing, size guides and offline-friendly catalog caching for iOS and Android.

components.name: Wishlist and recommendations
components.description: Personalised product recommendations and a synced wishlist driven by browsing and purchase history.

components.name: Mobile wallet payments
components.description: Apple Pay and Google Pay integration with tokenised cards and 3-D Secure step-up.

components.name: Push marketing campaigns
components.description: Segmented push campaigns with A/B testing and deep links into product pages.

project_summary: Remote patient monitoring app with wearable sync and anomaly alerts

components.description: Background sync of heart rate, SpO2 and activity from Apple HealthKit and Google Fit with deduplication.

components.name: Vitals charting
components.description: Interactive time-series charts of patient vitals with trend lines and shareable PDF summaries.

components.name: Operator HMI

components.name: Event logging
components.description: Structured event and fault logging with export for root-cause analysis.

components.name: Loan application flow

components.name: Automated disbursement

components.name: Observability
